prompt: Create a softly lit vertical anime-style illustration of a young adult woman waking up in a cozy bedroom, sitting upright on a rumpled bed and stretching both arms high above her head. She has long dark brown hair tied loosely back with wispy bangs, fair skin, round thin-rimmed glasses, closed sleepy eyes, and an open-mouthed yawn. She wears pale pink plaid button-up pajamas with a chest pocket, rolled sleeves, matching drawstring pants, and soft fabric wrinkles. The pose is natural and relaxed, with her torso slightly leaning back, arms extended out of frame near the top, and knees folded on the bed. The room is bright with warm morning sunlight streaming from a large window on the left through sheer curtains, creating soft highlights, gentle shadows, and a dreamy wake-up atmosphere. Include a white comforter and pillows in the foreground, a pastel pillow behind her, and a softly blurred background with shelves, baskets, small plants, a desk, and muted home decor. Use delicate linework, semi-realistic anime rendering, detailed skin blush, glossy hair highlights, shallow depth of field, high detail, warm pastel color grading, and a peaceful slice-of-life mood. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptZh: 创作一张光线柔和的竖版动漫风格插画，描绘一位 年轻女性 在舒适的卧室中醒来，坐在凌乱的床上，双手高举过头顶伸懒腰。她留着 深棕色长发，随意扎起并留有细碎刘海，皮肤白皙，戴着圆形细框眼镜，睡眼惺忪地闭着双眼，张嘴打着哈欠。她穿着 浅粉色格子纽扣睡衣，带有胸袋、卷起的袖口、配套的抽绳裤，以及柔软的布料褶皱。姿势自然放松，上半身微微后仰，双臂向上延伸至画框边缘，双膝在床上弯曲。房间明亮，温暖的晨光从左侧的大窗户透过半透明窗帘洒入，营造出柔和的高光、细腻的阴影和梦幻般的苏醒氛围。前景包含白色被子和枕头，身后有一个淡色系枕头，背景经过柔焦处理，可见架子、篮子、小盆栽、书桌和柔和的家居装饰。采用精致的线条、半写实动漫渲染、细腻的皮肤红晕、光泽的发丝高光、浅景深、高细节、暖色调的柔和配色，以及宁静的生活片段氛围。无文字，无水印，无多余角色。
